markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (75%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
Single-class conformal set, but the second model disagrees and 4 of 5 neighbors are Normal.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 75%, Normal 25% | Clear lead; Normal runner-up |
| Conformal set | Benign only | Single class at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% / 64th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign | Neighbors lean Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Prominent tubules; lower invasive association · Validated [F4]
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Scarce infiltrating stroma; lower invasive association · Validated [F3]
- **Normal lobules** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score, but spot check 0/20 · Unreliable [F2]
- **Nuclear size** (regions 6, 9, 10) · context · Smallest mean nuclear area in reference set · Measured [F7]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The second model and 4 of 5 neighbors point toward Normal, not Benign.
- The top concept failed its spot check; cell data covers only 3 of 12 regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 8, 11:** Confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 10:** Confirm gland architecture is benign, not atypical.
3. **Regions 6, 9, 10:** Check nuclei; mean size is lowest in the reference set.
